newsitem.title: COSTA RICA: Costa Rica prices rose 2.06 pct in January.
newsitem.headline: Costa Rica prices rose 2.06 pct in January.

text.p: Consumer prices rose 2.06 percent in Costa Rica in January, a much higher rate than the 1.27 percent in the same month a year earlier.
Economy Minister Jose Leon Desanti admitted to reporters that inflation had been higher than the government wanted.
"There were some inevitable factors which made the consumer price index deteriorate," he said, citing rises in urban bus transport, domestic service, fuel, school and laboratory examination prices.
December inflation was 1.08 percent and year-on-year inflation to the end of January 14.78 percent, against 19.14 percent a year earlier.
